Holding/pressing the input can extend the rush by consuming Ki; current skill evidence reports about 10% damage for the base sequence. The move is explicitly categorized as a Strike Evasive, correcting the prior Super classification.

records.name: Body Change

supported_fields.mechanics: 300-Ki Other Ultimate. The user fires a purple beam that functions as a grab; on a successful hit, the user and target swap bodies, including health, Ki, stamina, Super Soul, and skills, while retaining their original voices. Active transformations are released for both participants during the swap. Current Xenoverse 2-specific documentation states the skill is unavailable in PvE content, while it can be used in team battles; the target receives Body Change in the copied skill set but cannot activate it.
